lesson-intro.text: This planet wears a ring, and the ring goes behind it at the top and in front at the bottom. Watch which lines stop, then give one a ring of its own.

planet-top.text: Start with the planet. Curve over the top, from the ring on the left round to the ring on the right.

planet-bottom.text: Under the ring, close the planet with a wide curve, like the bottom of a ball.

ring-outer.text: The ring is a flat band. Draw its outside edge, a long oval that leans up to the right.

ring-inner.text: Now the inside edge. It crosses in front of the planet and follows the outside all the way round.

ring-ends.text: Two short lines close the hole, one on each side of the planet.

lesson-outro.text: A planet with a ring around its middle. Yours is tilted, just like the real one.
